statement.name: DeleteTask
statement.sql:
DECLARE @TaskCount AS INT DECLARE @TaskProcessId AS UniqueIdentifier
SELECT @TaskProcessId = t.TaskProcessId FROM dbo.PFM_EXT_TaskProcess tp inner join PFM_EXT_Task t on t.TaskProcessId = tp.TaskProcessId
SELECT @TaskCount = count(TaskId) from PFM_EXT_Task t
DELETE tf FROM dbo.PFM_EXT_TaskFields tf inner join PFM_EXT_Task t on t.Taskid = tf.TaskId
DELETE FROM dbo.PFM_EXT_Task
IF @TaskCount = 1 BEGIN delete from dbo.PFM_EXT_TaskProcessFields WHERE TaskProcessId = @TaskProcessId delete from dbo.PFM_EXT_TaskProcess WHERE TaskProcessId = @TaskProcessId END
